name: Closed Rings
description: Closed Rings is a CLI-first time tracker for developers and freelancers. You open a ring when you start a task, close it when you ship, and the tool captures everything in between — context switches, focus blocks, project totals — so you can stop reconstructing your week from memory. Standup summaries, focus reports, and invoice-ready exports come for free.
longDescription:
Ships **1 skill**, `closedrings-track-time` (Track time on Closed Rings via the closedrings MCP server) and **1 MCP server**, `closedrings`.

Installs with `claude plugin install closed-rings@claude-community` from `samacs/closedrings-mcp` (`plugins/closedrings`).

Closed Rings is a CLI-first time tracker for developers and freelancers. You open a ring when you start a task, close it when you ship, and the tool captures everything in between — context switches, focus blocks, project totals — so you can stop reconstructing your week from memory. Standup summaries, focus reports, and invoice-ready exports come for free.
